name: Lebensende
source:
Main character starts to live ordinary life after amnesia strike. One dark night he witnesses a beautiful girl fighting odd-shaped things. She asks to use her in the fight and turns into a mighty spiritual blade. Is this in some way connected to protagonist's past?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
失忆后，主人公开始过普通生活。某个漆黑夜晚，他目睹一名美丽女孩与奇形怪状的东西战斗。她请求将自己用于战斗，并变成一把强大的灵刀。这与主人公的过去有什么联系吗？

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
